moments.author: Shams Charania
moments.quote: Draymond Green has agreed to return to the Golden State Warriors on a one‑year, $27.7 million deal.
moments.why: Massive NBA free‑agency move by a major star resonating throughout basketball circles.

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Eagles are signing two‑time Pro‑Bowl DT Jalen Carter to a four‑year, $152 million extension... makes him the highest‑paid defensive tackle in NFL history.
moments.why: NFL record contract reset the market for interior defenders — huge for fans and fantasy leagues.

moments.author: NFL Network Insiders (Mike Garafolo & Ian Rapoport)
moments.quote: Two‑time Pro Bowl DT Vita Vea requests trade from Buccaneers.
moments.why: Trade request from a top defensive player immediately sparks speculation and team discussions league‑wide.

moments.author: The Athletic
moments.quote: Justin Bieber entered the Fanatics Games last‑minute, beat Tom Brady to take the $1M grand prize, then gave half to charity and split the rest among 50 fans.
moments.why: Surprising cultural moment mixing celebrity, sports, and generosity — widely shared and commented on.
